_comment: Each test's verdict from the very deep check's TEST WORTH section (practice: very-deep-check, Pass 2's question 27; tools/test_review.py reads this file).

verdicts: test name (a harness check_* function, or a test script's path) -> {verdict, importance, why, date, by, seconds, leads}. verdict is keep, cheapen or retire. A keep says its importance: high (work lost, leaked, landed in the wrong place, or a session blocked), medium (a mechanism quietly wrong), low (wording, formatting, a convenience). seconds is the recorded time when judged, and leads the leads it carried then: a keep is judged again when its time more than doubles, or a new lead appears. cheapen and retire are owed in the same pass; a cheapened test is recorded again as keep with its new time, and a retired test is deleted with its entry.
by: "agent" for the session's own call; a person's name, with strength (decided or assented), when the person decided it (practice: decision-strength).

retired: things that are gone, with the patterns a test that still exercises them would contain. A test naming one is a lead for the session, never a verdict: a test OF the retirement names it on purpose. tools/our_language.json's retired words, decommissioned tools/ paths and retired or deduplicated practices are read as well, so they are not repeated here.
